categories.main_business_segments: Dongbang Agro Corporation primarily operates in the manufacturing, processing, and sales of agricultural chemicals, including pesticides and fertilizers. The company produces various formulations such as emulsifiable concentrates, wettable powders, granules, and dispersible concentrates. It also engages in import and export related to agricultural products and materials. The subsidiary Dongbang Greenfarm supports its core business activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced automated production systems to manufacture multiple pesticide formulations, focusing on multifunctional and eco-friendly products. It emphasizes the development of biological pesticides and environmentally safe chemicals with high efficacy. Production capacity is based on daily output with a focus on quality control and innovation in formulation to meet customer preferences and regulatory standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (Nonghyup) and general retail distributors, with over 90% of sales occurring in the first half of the year. The company serves farmers and agricultural cooperatives primarily within South Korea. Its products are used in crop protection against pests, diseases, and weeds, targeting the domestic agricultural market.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dongbang Agro operates mainly within South Korea, with its manufacturing plant located in Buyeo, Chungnam Province, and headquarters in Seoul. While the company imports raw materials from international suppliers, its sales and operations are focused on the domestic market. Export sales exist but constitute a smaller portion of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the agricultural chemical supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and processing of pesticides and fertilizers. It imports raw materials from global chemical suppliers and produces finished products for distribution to agricultural cooperatives and retailers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing multifunctional, eco-friendly, and biologically based pesticides to meet evolving market demands and regulatory requirements. The company invests in R&D for new chemical registrations, improved formulations, and labor-saving pesticide types suitable for an aging farming population. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to enhance product efficacy and environmental safety.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured agricultural chemicals, including pesticides and fertilizers, to domestic agricultural cooperatives and retailers. The company operates on a credit sales basis with cash and promissory note collections. Export sales contribute a smaller share of revenue. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The domestic pesticide market is oligopolistic, dominated by both domestic and multinational companies. Dongbang Agro holds an estimated market share of approximately 12% as of 2023, maintaining a stable position amid competition from large multinational chemical firms. The company leverages its strong local presence and product portfolio to compete effectively.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Dongbang Agro is a mid-sized enterprise with total assets of approximately 224 billion KRW and equity of about 160 billion KRW as of 2023. The company reported sales of 164.3 billion KRW in 2023, reflecting a 12% increase from the previous year, and a net profit growth of 79%. It maintains a stable financial structure with a low debt ratio and strong liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, multifunctional, and environmentally friendly agricultural chemicals tailored to customer preferences and regulatory standards. Its automated production system ensures consistent product quality and efficiency. Dongbang Agro focuses on developing labor-saving formulations suitable for an aging farming workforce and offers a diverse product mix to address various crop protection needs.
